title: Cross-stage: hERG liability remediation loop
context: A lead compound shows a hERG liability on ADMET screening. You must decide whether a structurally modified analogue can advance. This is a causal cross-stage loop — the order matters: you cannot re-screen before redesigning, and you should not estimate PK or decide before the liability is confirmed fixed.
decision_required: Lay out the ordered cross-stage chain to reach an advance/hold decision on a fixed analogue. Finish with a line: chain: <step1> -> <step2> -> ...
source: N9 cross-stage causal loop (ADMET QC gate → redesign → re-screen → PK → decision). The execution variant runs each stage on Batch and grades artifacts via execution_grader. Ordering is objective.
